questions.question: Dr Rachid has successfully digitized his first optical impression. Dr Samia explains to him that the generated STL file is a mesh of triangles. What is the main characteristic of this format?
options: It contains color and texture information
It represents the surface of the object by triangular facets
It is compressed to reduce the file size
It contains the exact coordinates of the insertion axes
questions.explanation: Dr Samia explains: 'The STL format is a mesh of triangles that describes the surface of the object. It is the standard format for 3D printing and machining.'

questions.question: Dr Samia must choose an intraoral scanner for her practice. She hesitates between several brands. According to the selection criteria, which element is the most important?
questions.explanation: Dr Rachid explains: 'Accuracy and software fluidity are essential for an efficient workflow and reliable results.'

questions.question: Dr Rachid performed an intraoral scan but the STL file shows artifacts. Dr Samia advises him on a solution. What is the most likely cause of the artifacts?
options: Patient movement or poor saliva management
A defect in the ink cartridge
questions.explanation: Dr Samia explains: 'Artifacts are often due to patient movements or the presence of saliva or blood on the dental structures.'

questions.question: Dr Samia must design a crown on the CAD software. Dr Rachid reminds her of the importance of margins. What is the function of cervical margins?
options: They define the color of the crown
They ensure the adaptation of the crown to the dental preparation
They determine the height of the crown
questions.explanation: Dr Rachid explains: 'Cervical margins are essential for the adaptation of the crown to the preparation. Poor adaptation can lead to secondary caries.'

questions.question: Dr Rachid must choose between a 'chairside' workflow and a 'laboratory' workflow. According to the constraints of the practice, what is the main advantage of the 'chairside' workflow?
options: It allows the restoration to be finalized in a single session
It is more precise than the laboratory
questions.explanation: Dr Samia explains: 'The chairside workflow allows the impression, design and manufacture of the restoration in a single session, eliminating temporization.'

questions.question: Dr Samia must train an assistant in the use of the intraoral scanner. What is the first rule to teach her?
options: Managing patient movements and saliva aspiration
questions.explanation: Dr Rachid explains: 'The first rule is to master the management of movements and aspiration to obtain a quality scan.'

questions.question: Dr Rachid has designed a crown on the CAD software. Dr Samia asks him to check the proximal contacts. Why is this check important?
options: For the aesthetics of the crown
To avoid food impaction between teeth and ensure stability
For the color of the crown
For the height of the crown
questions.explanation: Dr Samia explains: 'Correct proximal contacts prevent food impaction between teeth and ensure the stability of the restoration.'

questions.question: Dr Samia must choose the export format of her file for machining. Which format is most commonly used for CAM?
questions.explanation: Dr Rachid explains: 'The STL format is the most commonly used for export to CAM machines.'

questions.question: Dr Rachid has received an STL file from a laboratory. He must check the quality of the scan. Which element is the most critical to control?
options: The presence of missing areas or artifacts
questions.explanation: Dr Samia explains: 'The presence of missing areas or artifacts can compromise the design and manufacture of the restoration.'

questions.question: Dr Samia must optimize the digital workflow. Which step is the most sensitive to errors?
questions.explanation: Dr Rachid explains: 'Optical acquisition is the most sensitive step. A poor-quality digital impression compromises all subsequent steps.'

questions.question: Dr Rachid must calibrate his machining machine. What is the recommended frequency for calibration?
options: Regularly, according to the manufacturer's recommendations
questions.explanation: Dr Samia explains: 'Regular calibration is essential to maintain machining precision.'

questions.question: Dr Samia has machined a lithium disilicate crown. Dr Rachid asks her to check the fit. What is the most precise control tool?
options: The control thread or verification dye
questions.explanation: Dr Rachid explains: 'The control thread or verification dye allows precise evaluation of the marginal fit of the crown.'

questions.question: Dr Rachid must choose between a monolithic zirconia crown or lithium disilicate. What is the main advantage of monolithic zirconia?
options: Its ability to be repaired at the chairside
questions.explanation: Dr Samia explains: 'Monolithic zirconia offers very high mechanical resistance, ideal for posterior sectors and bridges.'

questions.question: Dr Samia must decide on the type of crown for a patient with severe bruxism. Which material is the most suitable?
questions.explanation: Dr Rachid explains: 'Monolithic zirconia is the material of choice for bruxer patients due to its high resistance.'

questions.question: Dr Rachid has machined a monolithic zirconia crown. Dr Samia reminds him of the importance of glazing. What is the function of glazing?
options: Increase the resistance of the crown
Give an aesthetic and smooth appearance to the surface
Change the color of the crown
Reduce the thickness of the crown
questions.explanation: Dr Samia explains: 'Glazing gives an aesthetic and smooth appearance to the zirconia surface, improving its integration into the patient's smile.'

questions.question: Dr Samia must handle a complex case requiring a 4-unit bridge. Which material is the most suitable for this type of restoration?
questions.explanation: Dr Rachid explains: 'Zirconia is the material of choice for large-span bridges due to its resistance and dimensional stability.'

questions.question: Dr Rachid must choose a bur for machining a glassy ceramic. What characteristic should he look for?
questions.explanation: Dr Samia explains: 'Diamond burs are recommended for machining glassy ceramics due to their hardness and wear resistance.'

questions.question: Dr Samia has machined a machinable composite crown. Dr Rachid asks her to check the finishing. What is the recommended finishing step?
questions.explanation: Dr Rachid explains: 'Polishing with polishing discs allows obtaining a smooth and aesthetic surface on machinable composites.'

questions.question: Dr Rachid has received a 3D printed surgical guide. Dr Samia asks him to check the fit. What is the most reliable verification method?
options: Direct clinical fitting on the patient
questions.explanation: Dr Samia explains: 'Radiographic verification is the most reliable method to check the fit of the surgical guide.'

questions.question: Dr Samia must train her assistant in digital file management. What is the basic rule for archiving?
options: Archive on multiple media (cloud and local)
questions.explanation: Dr Rachid explains: 'Archiving on multiple media guarantees the security and longevity of digital data.'

questions.question: Dr Rachid has designed a crown on the CAD software. Dr Samia asks him to check the occlusion. Why is this check essential?
options: For the aesthetics of the crown
To avoid occlusal interferences and pain
For the color of the crown
For the height of the crown
questions.explanation: Dr Samia explains: 'Poorly adjusted occlusion can lead to pain, premature wear and failure of the restoration.'

questions.question: Dr Samia must manage a case of poorly sintered zirconia. Dr Rachid explains the possible causes. What is the most frequent cause?
options: A quality problem with the block
questions.explanation: Dr Rachid explains: 'A sintering temperature too low is the most frequent cause of poorly sintered zirconia, which can compromise the resistance of the restoration.'

questions.question: Dr Rachid must choose between dry machining and wet milling. What is the advantage of wet milling?
options: It reduces bur wear and avoids overheating
questions.explanation: Dr Samia explains: 'Wet milling reduces bur wear, avoids overheating and improves the quality of the machined surface.'

questions.question: Dr Samia has machined a lithium disilicate crown. Dr Rachid asks her to check the translucency. What is the importance of translucency?
options: It influences the integration of the crown into the smile
It increases the resistance of the crown
questions.explanation: Dr Rachid explains: 'The translucency of lithium disilicate allows the crown to integrate harmoniously into the patient's smile, imitating the optical properties of natural teeth.'

questions.question: Dr Rachid, after mastering the digital workflow, receives congratulations from Dr Samia: 'You are ready to train other practitioners.' What is the next step for Dr Rachid?
questions.explanation: Dr Samia explains: 'Training other practitioners is the best way to share expertise and advance the profession.'
